scientific_role: Deterministic baseline capture for a prospectively selected 80-block, pilot80-payload-disjoint causal transfer test. Extraction is engineering infrastructure and cannot select layers, directions, readouts, thresholds, blocks, models, or claims.

extraction_contract.hardware: NVIDIA H100 80GB; causal baselines and interventions must use the same GPU family and count per model

allowed_before_causal_execution: Bind exact activation output paths and SHA-256 hashes.
Verify item order, tensor shape, layers, token lengths, finite float32 values, model revisions, GPU inventory, and source hashes.
Copy the already-computed pilot80 orthogonalized-C directions, random controls, normalization scales, and readouts without refitting or selecting.
Create and hash the transfer causal plans and causal config before any nonzero transfer intervention output exists.
forbidden: Inspect or generate any nonzero transfer intervention output before the causal config and plans are frozen.
Refit directions or readouts on the transfer bank.
Change blocks, layers, models, endpoints, thresholds, seeds, or decision rules after extraction.
Call the pre-existing full320 item bank an independent item-bank confirmation.
Analyze excluded partial data if any fail-closed gate trips.

stopping_rule: If either extraction violates the immutable contract or the later same-environment batch-one baseline reproduction gate fails, retain the failure and stop without relaxing gates or using partial outcomes.
